en.title: Love Lifted Me
en.author: James Rowe
stanzas:
[A]I was sinking deep in sin, far from the peaceful [E7]shore,
Very deeply stained within, sinking to rise no [A]more,
But the Master of the sea heard my despairing [D]cry,
From the waters [A]lifted me, [D]now [E7]safe am [A]I.

All my heart to Him I give, ever to Him I'll cling,
In His blessed presence live, ever His praises sing,
Love so mighty and so true, merits my soul's best songs,
Faithful, loving service, too, to Him belongs.

Souls in danger, look above, Jesus completely saves,
He will lift you by His love, out of the angry waves;
He's the Master of the sea, billows His will obey,
He your Savior wants to be, be saved today.
en.chorus:
[A]Love [E7]lifted [A]me!
Love lifted [D]me!
When nothing [A]else could help,
[B7]Love lifted [E]me!
[A]Love [E7]lifted [A]me!
Love lifted [D]me!
When nothing [A]else could help,
[A]Love [E7]lifted [A]me.

notes: Text from Timeless Truths (Evening Light Songs #506), which prints each 7.6 pair on one line; hymnary's representative text (One Lord, One Faith, One Baptism #494) breaks them in two and differs only in line-initial capitals and a few line-end marks. TT's four-line refrain is the short form; the score repeats it (first ending on V, second on I), and hymnary prints the eight-line form, so the eight lines ship, with the two endings charted as the score has them: B7-E the first time, A-E7-A the second. Tune SAFETY (Howard E. Smith, 1912), meter 7.6.7.6.7.6.7.4 with refrain. Key: hymnary's instances run 46 B-flat to 1 A-flat; TT prints B-flat. Moved to A for guitar per the key rule. Chords derived from the Timeless Truths MusicXML score by reading the four-part chord on every beat, transposed B-flat to A. The stanza is I for three lines with 6th and maj7 colour tones dropped, V7 at 'shore', I at 'more', IV at 'cry', then I-IV-V7-I through 'lifted me, now safe am I'. Refrain bars 'Love lifted me! (even me)' carry a vii-dim7 and ii under the echo that were dropped. COPYRIGHT: words and music 1912, public domain in the United States; Rowe died 1933 and Smith 1918, so both have been clear under life-plus-70 terms since 2004.
